title: Mihulish replaces old helper, farm archive and events updates
summary: Mihulish replaced the verification-dependent TheySix Helper, farm archive and events were updated, channels were organized, and @mihulish was added for staff tools.
description: Major changes on September 1st: Mihulish replaced the old helper bot, the farm archive and events received updates, channels were reorganized, and @mihulish was added to support staff tools.

body.text: Replaced the verification-dependent TheySix Helper with Mihulish; staff can use its commands and send suggestions through the staff channel.
Added developing /dn farm-link delivery, uploaded schematics 529 through 510, added a site schematic renderer, and introduced 19 event minigames for testing.
Archived inactive channels, added a self-promotion sticky message, and gave Staff Team and TSE Player access to game chat.
Added @mihulish to support staff tools and ongoing server automation.
